name: rn-devtools-hub
description: Drive a running React Native or Expo app from inside its JS runtime: semantic UI perception with source locations, actions without coordinates, structured assertions, deterministic time and network, and correlated session export.

interface.shortDescription: See a running React Native app the way React sees it, act on it, and prove it works.
interface.longDescription:
The SDK runs inside the app's JavaScript runtime, which is what an accessibility or WebDriver driven tool cannot reach. The agent finds elements by role and accessible name and acts through the app's own props rather than pixel coordinates, gets the source file and line behind each element (symbolicated against Metro), proves a step with assertions that catch what a screenshot cannot show, freezes the clock and the network for reproducible runs, and exports a session as one correlated timeline.

The hub runs locally on Bun or Node and nothing leaves the machine.
